title: RL: rollout, reward and training as separate components of one job
design_ref: RL: choosing the objective; Rollout generation; Rewards and verifiers

checks.description: one JobSet with two parts, rollout and trainer, that succeeds when the trainer does
checks.because: The launcher renders an RL recipe in server mode as a JobSet whose success policy targets the trainer only.

checks.description: Kueue admitted the run as one Workload asking for both GPUs at once
checks.because: JobSet is a Kueue integration: each replicated job is a pod set of one Workload, and admission is all or nothing.

checks.description: every step logged the design's health signals: reward, entropy, length, clipping, importance ratios, gradient norm
checks.because: TRL's GRPOTrainer computes them; the tracking callback writes every logged row to S3 as the run goes.

checks.description: the signals could be read before the run finished
checks.because: metrics.jsonl is rewritten after every logged step; the reading was taken while status.json said running.

checks.description: generation and weight sync were measured; the trainer pushed new weights to the rollout server every step
checks.because: The trainer wraps TRL's generate and sync_weights calls with timers. Each step: sync weights over NCCL to the server, then generate the next batch.

checks.description: the rewards came from the verifier pool, which ran model-written code thousands of times
checks.because: The trainer's reward functions call the verifier Service; the pool's counters, not the trainer's logs, are the evidence.

checks.description: a checkpoint was written every 20 steps and the last two are kept
checks.because: save_steps=20; after each save the callback uploads the checkpoint and deletes all but the newest two.

checks.description: the RL model is registered with its base (the promoted SFT model) and its prompt data
checks.because: The launcher resolved @promoted to one run before launch; the registry entry keeps both the reference and what it resolved to.

notes: Gate verdict for the RL model: promoted.
